verification.model: controlled loopback HTTP fixture; no user endpoint or credentials read

toolErrorDiagnostics.scope: In-memory native tool error serialization only. Bounded safe transport cause codes in optional error.info and readable error text; no cause messages, addresses, stacks or credentials. Preserve native approval, cancellation, outcome and retry ownership.
toolErrorDiagnostics.exitCondition: Remove when an upgraded native serializer retains equivalent safe causes; source hash drift requires review.

requestFitRecovery.approved: 2026-10-28: locked SDK contract repair; no dependency upgrade, new host loop or Session v4 migration
requestFitRecovery.scope: Checked in-memory transforms at the native LLM, Pi adapter, basic compaction and retry module URLs. One normalized request projection supplies fit and dispatch. Local exhaustion rejects before HTTP; short length uses the original desired cap. Native compaction may recover once per turn only after a surface replacement and improved fit. Generic transport retry cannot replenish that allowance.
requestFitRecovery.storage: Existing failure code and requestId only. Request fit and remeasurement closures are transient, one-use, bounded and superseded by a new main request for the same session. Service usage and historical finish records are not rewritten.
requestFitRecovery.usageEvidence: The public Pi provider-stream callback observes explicit output counters for the three supported APIs. Missing counters remain unknown even when Pi normalizes them to zero. Length recovery and length-based overflow require the reported counter to match the normalized output; explicit provider errors retain their original classification.
requestFitRecovery.minimumOutput: Fit includes the protocol minimum. For Responses with max_output_tokens enabled, this is 16: an explicitly smaller desired cap fails INVALID_OUTPUT_BUDGET before HTTP, without compaction or transport retries; insufficient context allowance fails local budget recovery. Allowed dispatches never rely on Pi silently raising the wire cap. Existing explicit supportsMaxOutputTokens=false remains an opt-out of the wire cap.
requestFitRecovery.instructionRetention: The shared native range selector preserves the latest original source.kind=user event, even with generated role-user context after it. Within the existing retained-tail cutoff, it selects a larger priced balanced span on either side, preferring spans other than a lone checkpoint. Forced/manual compaction may still use a lone checkpoint when no other span is eligible; the existing pressure guard skips it. Long-turn tool history remains compactable. No user event is copied, reordered or synthesized; Session v4 and the native summary transaction remain unchanged. Later-span summaries may lose prefix-cache reuse. This protects the latest input verbatim, not arbitrary facts in every older summary.
requestFitRecovery.summaryPreparation: The final adapter fit must reserve the complete desired compaction output. COMPACTION_OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED is a zero-HTTP preflight result carried by the existing transient sidecar. Native compaction geometrically shortens balanced ends within its original transaction and rebuilds input, prices and shadowed events together. Unsummarized tail nodes remain active. A bound registration/configuration continuation traverses the existing middleware and final projection and consumes the same prepared request for fit and dispatch. Preparation is finite but not exhaustive; only the final fitting candidate dispatches one summary HTTP. Actual length, cancellation or no fitting candidate commits no checkpoint. The existing pressure checkpoint guard also checks the final shortened input. No host loop or Session migration is introduced.
requestFitRecovery.removal: Replace with equivalent upstream prepared-request fit and bounded recovery contracts when available. Re-review all pinned modules/helpers on upgrade; fail startup on drift or late loading. Do not remove only the loader while retaining its consumers.

subagentReturnContract.scope: In-memory replacement of the child bootstrap and delegation-tool wording only. Native final delivery, optional send_message, lifecycle, permissions and persisted histories remain upstream-owned.
subagentReturnContract.removal: Remove on an upstream automatic-final-report contract; dependency upgrades must re-review these exact pinned sources.
